Comments: NITA-U Act 2009 establishes mandate for e-governance coordination. Data Protection and Privacy Act enacted. e-GIF v2 issued as mandatory standard for all MDAs/LGs. Digital Uganda Vision (DUV) policy framework. Multiple enabling laws confirmed for cross-government data sharing.
